channel.title: Jobs on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Jobs on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Job
item.description: This section describes how to create a Job. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Refer to Parameter Description to set the Job parameters. Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: View Job List
item.description: This section describes how to view the Job list. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workloads View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workloads View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Job or CronJob in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Job Details
item.description: This section describes how to view Job details. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workloads View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workloads View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Application Workloads > Jobs or CronJobs in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Job Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit Job information. You can edit the alias and description of a Job. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a created Job. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: Rerun a Job
item.description: This section describes how to rerun a Job. This operation is only available for regular Jobs. Note KubeSphere only allows rerunning Jobs that have ended. This operation is not supported for Jobs that are currently running. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles.

item.title: Pause a CronJob
item.description: This section describes how to suspend a CronJob. After a CronJob is suspended, the system will not create and run Jobs at the scheduled future times. Running Jobs are not affected. This operation is only available for CronJobs. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Application Workload Management permissions and enter your cluster.

item.title: Delete a Job
item.description: This section describes how to delete a Job. Warning This operation will delete the Job and all pods managed by it. If the Job is running, the ongoing business will be interrupted. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Application Workload Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles.
